name: HEXR Smart SEO – 1-Click SEO Automation & AI Optimizer
author: MD Hasan

sections.description:
HEXR Smart SEO by Hexer IT is an autonomous all-in-one WordPress SEO suite. It automatically optimizes your content for search engines like Google and Bing, synchronizing seamlessly with Rank Math, Yoast SEO, and All in One SEO.

Key Features:

  • 1-Click Full Site SEO Optimization: Generate high-ranking Meta Titles (50-60 chars) and Meta Descriptions (145-160 chars) adhering to Google search best practices.
  • Review & Approve Co-Pilot Mode: AI drafts SEO proposals and presents a side-by-side comparison for your 1-click review and approval before going live.
  • Autonomous Mode: Automatically optimizes and publishes metadata directly to your live site without manual intervention.
  • Smart Contextual Image Alt Text Generator: Automatically synthesizes descriptive, keyword-rich alt tags from image subject, page content, WooCommerce categories, and brand niche.
  • Dynamic XML Sitemaps: Generates clean, fast sitemaps for posts, pages, WooCommerce products, and images at /sitemap.xml.
  • Robots.txt & 301 Redirect Manager: Control search engine crawlers and fix broken 404 links directly from the dashboard.
  • AI Router Cloud Gateway & BYO API Key Support: Use zero-configuration cloud AI with daily free optimizations, or connect your own personal OpenRouter, Google Gemini, Groq, or OpenAI API key.

Privacy Policy

This plugin connects to external AI services (OpenAI API via AI Router Gateway) to provide automated SEO titles, descriptions, and metadata.
* Terms of Service: https://ai-router.hexerit.com/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://ai-router.hexerit.com/privacy-policy
* Service Provider: AI Router Gateway / OpenAI API

External or 3rd Party Service Notice

This plugin relies on external AI cloud services to analyze content excerpts and generate SEO metadata.

  1. AI Router Cloud Gateway (Default):

    • Service URL: The plugin communicates with the AI Router Gateway (https://ai-router.hexerit.com/v1) operated by Hexer IT.
    • Purpose: Acts as a secure intermediary proxy to route prompts, manage daily optimization quotas, and protect upstream AI credentials.
    • Data Sent: Post title, post type, and an excerpt of the post content (up to 4,000 characters) when the user triggers an optimization. No personal user data, visitor data, or database credentials are ever transmitted.
    • Terms of Service: https://ai-router.hexerit.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://ai-router.hexerit.com/privacy-policy

  2. Direct Third-Party AI Providers (Optional BYO Key):

    • If you choose Custom AI Provider mode in settings, the plugin communicates directly with your chosen provider using your personal API key:
      • OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai (Terms: https://openrouter.ai/terms | Privacy: https://openrouter.ai/privacy)
      • Google Gemini: https://ai.google.dev (Terms: https://ai.google.dev/terms | Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy)
      • Groq Cloud: https://groq.com (Terms: https://groq.com/terms-of-use/ | Privacy: https://groq.com/privacy-policy)
      • OpenAI: https://openai.com (Terms: https://openai.com/terms | Privacy: https://openai.com/privacy)
      • Ollama / Local Custom Proxy: (e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1). Runs locally on your own infrastructure. No data is sent to external third parties.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the hexr-smart-seo folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to HEXR Smart SEO -> Settings to configure your preferred AI mode (AI Router Cloud Gateway or your personal API key).
  4. Run 1-Click optimization on any post, page, or product from the dashboard or directly inside the block editor.
sections.faq:
Do I need a paid API key to use this plugin?

No! In AI Router Cloud Gateway mode, you receive daily free optimizations for Posts, Pages, and WooCommerce Products without entering any API key. Alternatively, you can use your own free API keys from OpenRouter, Google Gemini, or Groq.

Does this plugin work with Rank Math or Yoast SEO?

Yes! HEXR Smart SEO automatically detects and syncs with Rank Math, Yoast SEO, and All in One SEO metadata. If no third-party SEO plugin is installed, it outputs native schema and meta tags directly into your site header.

Can visitors or third parties view my upstream AI credentials?

No. In AI Router Gateway mode, upstream credentials and routing endpoints remain securely stored on your private gateway server. The WordPress plugin never holds or exposes your upstream keys.

How do Custom AI Providers work?

If you prefer to bypass the AI Router Cloud Gateway, you can switch to “Custom AI Provider” mode under HEXR Smart SEO -> Settings. You can input your own personal API key from OpenRouter, Google Gemini, Groq, OpenAI, or connect a local LLM (like Ollama at http://localhost:11434/v1). In this mode, the plugin connects directly from your WordPress server to the provider’s API endpoint without routing through any intermediary.

  • Optimized transient caching for SEO post metadata synchronization.
  • Enhanced admin dashboard UI with complete notice isolation.
  • Full compatibility with WordPress 6.0 – 7.1 and PHP 7.0 – 8.3+.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of HEXR Smart SEO.
  • Autonomous Review & Approve mode.
  • AI Router Cloud Gateway and BYO key integration.
  • Dynamic XML sitemaps and smart image alt text fixer.
